messages.content: Generate one realistic cold-chain disruption scenario as JSON. Only emit description and disruptions. Generate at least one disruption. sensor_bias value is Celsius bias added to sensor reading, between -5 and +5. cooling_failure value is available cooling fraction between 0 and 1. door_stuck value must be 1. Use only existing zone IDs. Events must fit the horizon; same kind and zone events must not overlap. Do not change stock, temperatures, products, orders or physics parameters. Use only existing zone IDs. Events must fit the horizon; same kind and zone events must not overlap. Do not change stock, temperatures, products, orders or physics parameters.
